items.textToSpeech: Copper contributes to: normal energy-yielding metabolism, normal functioning of the nervous system, normal skin and hair pigmentation, normal iron transport in the body, normal function of the immune system, the protection of cells from oxidative stress, and the maintenance of normal connective tissues.

The European Commission has authorised these claims for products which contain at least 150 micrograms of copper per 100 grams, per 100 millilitres or per package, if the package contains only a single portion. Is there anything else I can help you with?
